note: Explicit, word-specific teaching overlays on NRC alignments. Every source index must occur exactly once, in order. These merge a sound-bearing letter and its aligned silent partner; they do not invent or change pronunciation.

boat.reason: Teach the oa vowel team together; NRC assigns OW to o and an epsilon to a.

chip.reason: Teach the ch digraph together; NRC assigns CH to c and an epsilon to h.

see.reason: Teach the ee vowel team together; NRC gives one e an epsilon.
